mapper.sql: sch.id, sch.doctor_id, doc.name AS doctor_name, doc.title AS doctor_title, doc.department_id, dept.name AS department_name, sch.work_date, sch.period, sch.start_time, sch.end_time, sch.total_slots, sch.available_slots, (sch.total_slots - sch.available_slots) AS booked_slots, sch.registration_fee, sch.status, sch.create_time, sch.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM schedule sch INNER JOIN doctor doc ON doc.id = sch.doctor_id INNER JOIN department dept ON dept.id = doc.department_id WHERE sch.id = #{id} AND sch.status = 1 AND doc.status = 1 AND dept.status = 1 AND CONCAT(sch.work_date, ' ', sch.start_time) > NOW()

SELECT FROM schedule sch INNER JOIN doctor doc ON doc.id = sch.doctor_id INNER JOIN department dept ON dept.id = doc.department_id
ORDER BY sch.work_date DESC, sch.start_time DESC, sch.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule sch INNER JOIN doctor doc ON doc.id = sch.doctor_id INNER JOIN department dept ON dept.id = doc.department_id
SELECT FROM schedule sch INNER JOIN doctor doc ON doc.id = sch.doctor_id INNER JOIN department dept ON dept.id = doc.department_id WHERE sch.id = #{id}
SELECT id, doctor_id, work_date, period, start_time, end_time, total_slots, available_slots, registration_fee, status, create_time, update_time FROM schedule WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, doctor_id, work_date, period, start_time, end_time, total_slots, available_slots, registration_fee, status, create_time, update_time FROM schedule WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule (doctor_id, work_date, period, start_time, end_time, total_slots, available_slots, registration_fee, status) VALUES (#{doctorId}, #{workDate}, #{period}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{totalSlots}, #{availableSlots}, #{registrationFee}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule SET doctor_id = #{doctorId}, work_date = #{workDate}, period = #{period}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, total_slots = #{totalSlots}, available_slots = #{availableSlots}, registration_fee = #{registrationFee}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
